name: Palette-based compression for chunked discrete voxel data
definition: A compression technique for discrete voxel data (e.g., Minecraft blocks) that separates block groups/chunks from their actual storage using a structure called BlockStorage. It uses a palette of block types/states and variable-bit-length indices pointing to that palette, similar to GIF color palettes.
summary: Palette-based compression reduces memory by storing sparse block types in a palette and variable-length indices in a bit buffer, achieving 1-2 bits per voxel.
